ijssel: IJssel is a river in the central Netherlands flowing north to the IJsselmeer.
IJssel means the same as IJssel river.
ijssel river: IJssel river is a river in the central Netherlands flowing north to the IJsselmeer.
IJssel river means the same as IJssel.
ijsselmeer: IJsselmeer is a shallow lake in northwestern Netherlands created in 1932 by building a dam across the entrance to the Zuider Zee.
ijtihad: An ijtihad is the endeavor of a Moslem scholar to derive a rule of divine law from the Koran and Hadith without relying on the views of other scholars.
For example: "Some reform-minded Islamic scholars believe that reopening ijtihad is a prerequisite for the survival of Islam."
